Name: Talkohlooey Style A.G.E Portraits
Author: Aelinore
Description:
[size=3][b]About:[/b] [/size][size=2]An attempt at Talkohlooey styled portraits for Adventurer's Guild Expanded. Please note, this is the first time I've ever made a mod for Stardew Valley so please be gentle. To install, download the ZIP and extract [CP] Talkohlooey AGE Portraits into your Stardew Valley mods folder! [i](+ any required mods.)[/i]

[i][size=4][color=red][b]* Due to school and work life, I have no idea when I will have the time to update or fix any of my mods. So long as it is non-profit/non-commercial and the original is linked back to, I am 10000% OK with others using my work and publishing UPDATES/UPDATED versions. If other mod author's assets are used in my mod, you must get their permission before publishing any updates. Thank-you for downloading my original and I'm sorry I haven't been able to update. :([/b][/color][/size][/i]

[/size][b][size=3]Required:[/size][/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits
[/url]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12102]Adventurer's Guild Expanded[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269]talkohlooeys' Portraits[/url] [i][size=1](Optional, but this mod was meant to be used with these!)

[/size][/i][b][u][size=3]FAQ:[/size][/u][/b]
[b]Play tested?[/b]
- Yes and no. I haven't gone far into AGE's storyline to see if there are any slip-ups. If you see something, let me know!

[b]Can I edit these and share them?[/b]
- Yes, please at least link back to this mod though! :)

[b]Seasonal Outfits?[/b]
- They're coming! This took forever to figure out how to put together, so it'll be a bit before I figure out seasonal outfits. 
[i][size=2](If anyone wants to help put it together after the portraits are made, I'd appreciate it!)[/size][/i]

[b]Will you do portraits for xxx mod?[/b]
- Maybe? Leave a request in the comments and I'll consider it!


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52049741]Lokelios[/url] for their portrait template that I would have been lost without!
